page.overview:
Who is Poyko Nen?

Poyko Nen was a Captain of the Guard in the service of House Harkonnen.

Poyko Nen served House Harkonnen as a Captain of the Guard. He was in command when House Atreides carried out a suicide raid, destroying valuable resources. Nen was hated by many due to his failure to stop the Atreides and was placed in the slave pens on Giedi Prime as punishment.

Nen was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Amado Delsin, Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, the Grey Lady, the Morani Twins and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition began, he struggled in the Web of Deception. He managed to escape, though he barely survived the effort. He was pursued by the Fremen when he and Shiff reached the Abyssal Chamber, where they circled each other over the bottomless pit. She fired at his with her needle gun, but he deflected them with his makeshift shield and retaliated with a swift strike from his dagger. The brutal showdown continued until he threw his weight against her and sent her falling into the pit.

Gravely wounded, Nen was almost attacked by the Fremen until the twins scaled the walls and cut off his path. Using the opportunity to escape, the crowd were displeased by Nen's cowardice. The Fremen continued to pursue him upon overcoming the twins until Nen reached the path of Kanto. As Kanto charged at him, Nen used a hidden mechanism to open a wall and trap Kanto in a chamber filled with venomous rock lizards. He later encountered the Grey Lady and attacked her. She was surprisingly strong and fast, but he managed to tear off her veil, revealing her scarred and disfigured face. Kanto arrived and ordered the rock lizards to attack. The Grey Lady fled as the rock lizards overpowered Nen and tore him apart.
